steps.title: Levels 80–90
steps.text: Follow the blue-marker Main Scenario Quest; it unlocks each zone and duty in order.
tips: Hub cities are Old Sharlayan and Radz-at-Han.

steps.title: Zones to visit
tips: Attune to each aetheryte as you arrive – it makes teleporting free of travel time later.

steps.title: Story dungeons
tips: Exact unlock levels are in the Duty Finder; story dungeons are MSQ-gated.

steps.title: Add your own waypoints
steps.text: Add a "target": {"zone":..., "x":..., "y":..., "label":...} to any step to get a direction arrow. See the README.
